authority_levels.approve: Executor posts the step and waits for an analyst to approve it.
authority_levels.recommend_only: Executor writes the step into the plan and never dispatches it.

eradication.note: The analyst executes these through the action surface, so the framework still times the phase and MTTE stays measured.

recovery.note: reverse_only_live_actions keeps recovery off entries the ledger recorded as shadow, which never happened and so cannot be undone.

star.note: Any matching rule stars the case; the matched rule's reason is recorded and shown. Fields are read from the promoted assessment namespace. A field that is absent never counts as a match. Operators: eq, in, gte. star_field is the incidents API update_data field and must be confirmed on a tenant before relying on it.

ticketing.note: Ticket scope is the case. Per-issue tickets rebuild the alert storm that case grouping exists to remove.
